title: Cherrypicking Protocol for High-Throughput Workflows
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

steps.title: Load tip racks and plates
steps.instruction: Place tip‑rack(s) in Slot 1; if using more than 96 tips, also place additional tip‑racks in Slots 4, 7, and 10. Load the source plate in Slot 2 (or, for multiple source plates, load Plate 1 in Slot 2, Plate 2 in Slot 5, Plate 3 in Slot 8, and Plate 4 in Slot 11). Load the destination plate in Slot 3. The destination plate will receive each cherry‑picking transfer sequentially, filling wells A1, then B1, etc.

steps.title: Create CSV file for transfers
steps.instruction: Create a comma‑separated values (.csv) file that lists each transfer, including the source well, destination well (or let the robot fill sequentially), and the transfer volume, following the required format.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol generator, upload the CSV file and select all desired settings (e.g., tip‑rack type, pipette, volumes) as described in the setup section.

steps.title: Download OT‑2 protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deck map to download the customized OT‑2 Python protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol and calibrate deck
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol, and follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck, calibrate the labware, and prepare for the run.

steps.title: Add samples to source plate
steps.instruction: Add your samples to the source plate(s) before placing them on the robot deck; ensure the source plate contains the samples you want to cherry‑pick.
